name: jarvis-notes-bridge
description: Obsidian plugin: ask the local Jarvis about the note or selection you are reading, and drive note edits through Jarvis's own one-card routes. Read-only in the vault: the plugin never writes a note and never approves a card.

scripts.test: node --test tests/protocol.test.mjs tests/templates.test.mjs tests/safety.test.mjs tests/accessibility.test.mjs tests/fake-jarvis.test.mjs
scripts.test:sandbox: node --experimental-test-isolation=none --test tests/protocol.test.mjs tests/templates.test.mjs tests/safety.test.mjs tests/accessibility.test.mjs tests/fake-jarvis.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:build-drift && npm test
